chunks: Whoever hears the adhan and says as the mu'adhdhin says, there will be an increase in his sustenance.

key_terms.الْمُؤَذِّنُ: the one who calls the adhan

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for repeating the adhan after the mu'adhdhin?
ai.summary: This hadith states that whoever hears the adhan and repeats the words of the mu'adhdhin is granted an increase in sustenance. It highlights a spiritual practice connected to salat (prayer) that carries worldly blessing.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Whoever hears the adhan (call to prayer) and repeats what the mu'adhdhin (caller to prayer) says will have an increase in their sustenance."
